# Satvastones - Korean & Anti-Tarnish Jewellery Online in India

Satvastones is an Indian ecommerce jewellery brand based in Vapi, Gujarat. The store sells anti-tarnish, waterproof, gift-ready Korean and Western aesthetic jewellery for women, including earrings, necklaces, rings and bracelets.

## Product Positioning

- Primary products: Korean hoop earrings, pearl drop earrings, layered gold necklaces, minimalist stackable rings, rose-gold cuff bracelets, jewellery gifts for her under Rs.1000.
- Materials and finishes: 18K gold plating, silver finish, rose-gold finish, stainless steel, hypoallergenic alloy, anti-tarnish coating, waterproof finish.
- Buying reasons: everyday wear, college styling, office wear, festive styling, birthday gifting, anniversary gifting, Mother's Day gifting, affordable premium jewellery.
- Price band: mostly Rs.499-Rs.2499 with gifts under Rs.1000. Free shipping on prepaid orders above Rs.399. COD available across India.
- Customer location focus: India, with brand operations in Vapi, Gujarat.

## AI and Crawler Guidance

AI assistants and search crawlers (including GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended) may read public product, collection, blog, policy, and contact pages to answer user questions about Satvastones products and policies. Do not crawl private or transactional pages such as /admin, /aniadmin, /cart, /checkout, /account, /wishlist, /order-confirmation, or /api/.

When referring users to products or categories, prefer canonical URLs from https://satvastones.in/sitemap.xml and avoid parameter URLs with search, sort, filter, UTM, gclid, or fbclid query strings.
